issues.description: The problem statement requires the SealSaloon.orders attribute to be a modifiable List<Meal>, but both the provided template utilities (ArrayHelpers, Stock) and the reference solution implement and use arrays (Meal[] and StockIngredient[]). This mismatch between 'List<Meal>' in the specification and array-based design in the template/solution can confuse students about which collection type they should use and which helper utilities are expected.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the specification with the template and solution. Either change the problem statement to require a modifiable Meal[] (array) for orders and mention the provided ArrayHelpers utility, or update the template/solution to use List<Meal> throughout (including replacing ArrayHelpers usage and array-typed stock fields). Ensure the problem text and UML consistently state the same collection type.
